name: synapsidian-work
description: Work add-on for the synapsidian plugin: 1:1 notes and prep, the stand-up note, retro meeting notes, a win log for performance reviews, pull requests, Jira tickets, and email and Slack asks in the morning brief.

github_repos.title: GitHub repositories
github_repos.description: owner/name of each repository whose pull requests the morning brief and stand-up read. Leave empty to skip pull requests.

jira_projects.title: Jira project keys
jira_projects.description: Key of each Jira project the brief and stand-up query, e.g. ABC. Leave empty to skip Jira.

work_repo_paths.title: Work repository paths
work_repo_paths.description: Absolute path of each local clone the stand-up reads `git log` from. Leave empty to skip it.

standup_days.title: Stand-up days
standup_days.description: Weekdays the stand-up happens, comma-separated three-letter names, e.g. mon,tue,wed,thu,fri.

standup_time.title: Stand-up time
standup_time.description: Local time the stand-up starts, HH:MM. The note is prepared an hour before.
